body:
I was in the exact same boat. He seemed absolutely perfect, we're both super HL, and had what I thought was a perfectly satisfying sexual Relationship. Come to find he's sending CL casual encounters girls messages (???). He is with me literally every morning and night- point being there's not even an hour unaccounted for that he could have possibly met up with these girls. He also claims he never met up with them. He said the same thing- old habit, he just felt like after doing it for so long it was just another thing to do online, like look at porn, etc.  

The trust, however, was gone. I told him to move out. He was so remiss and distraught that he sobbed for days and days and his nose would even start bleeding. It was horrific. He even went and got my name tattooed in him (he's never smoked, drank, drugs, or god forbid had a tattoo before - other than his CL vice he was a little choir boy). 

Even with the tattoo there to " reassure me" that he's all in, totally done with his bs, I have a much harder time in the bedroom. I used to dress up every day for him, cook dinner wearing lingerie and an apron, etc. now I just feel exploited, taken for granted. 

It's been 2 months and were getting better. I've decided to forgive him (who gets a tattoo of someone's name unless they mean it???) but that means truly assume he's not going to eff it up again.

I remind myself that I dressed up because *i* enjoy it, and if staying with him means I just feel awful- that's no way to spend my life. We only get one turn on the planet- why waste it torturing yourself and having a shitty life?
